feedback_text: Please ensure subscription renewals follow plan billing_interval and prorate on mid-cycle changes.
MRR should divide total monthly revenue by distinct organization count, not subscription count.
Churn rate should count distinct organizations that cancelled, not individual subscription cancellations.
ARPU should sum revenue and divide by paying users, not all registered users including trials.
Customer lifetime value should sum all paid invoices per organization, not count subscriptions.
Renewal rate should divide renewed subscriptions by subscriptions up for renewal, not by all subscriptions.
Trial conversion rate should divide trials that became paid by total trials started, not by user signups.
Payment success rate should count succeeded payments divided by total payment attempts, not by invoice count.
Expansion MRR should sum additional revenue from upgrades, not count upgrade events.
